items.title: Best Buy and Amazon Expand Fire TV Partnership Into Connected TV Advertising
items.summary: Best Buy (NYSE:BBY) and Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) have expanded their multiyear Fire TV partnership to include connected television advertising, extending an existing agreement covering Best Buy’s Insignia TVs. Under the agreement, Fire TV will remain the exclusive software experience across all Insignia televisions produced by Best Buy, with models ranging from 24 to 85 inches.

items.title: Best Buy Co Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: Best Buy Co Inc (NYSE:BBY) recently announced a total dividend of $0.96 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-17.  This amount consists entirely of a $0.96 per share cash dividend, which is payable to shareholders on 2026-10-08.  For investors, the ex-dividend date is a critical marker: shareholders must own the stock before this date to qualify for the payment.
